remediation: Issue short-lived JWTs with minimal claims only; remove password hashes, TOTP secrets, entitlement tokens, and other user records from token payloads and require exp/aud/iss validation.

finding: Customer JWT Can Access Bulk Users and Authentication Details
target: OWASP Juice Shop v14.5.1 user/authentication APIs:3000
remediation: Restrict bulk user/authentication endpoints to admins and redact sensitive fields from all responses.

finding: Product Search SQL Injection
target: OWASP Juice Shop product search API on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Parameterize product search queries and never concatenate q directly into SQL.

finding: XXE Local File Disclosure in Deprecated File Upload
target: OWASP Juice Shop file upload endpoint on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Disable external entity processing and reject XML DOCTYPE/ENTITY declarations in uploaded files.

finding: Exposed Premium Key Enables Unauthorized Deluxe Membership Upgrade
target: OWASP Juice Shop deluxe membership API on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Remove premium.key from the web root and replace static-token upgrades with server-side payment verification.

finding: Length-Extension Forgery Accepted for Deluxe Payment Token
target: OWASP Juice Shop deluxe membership API on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Replace secret-prefix hashes with HMAC-SHA256 and verify payments server-to-server.

finding: Logout Fails and Does Not Invalidate JWTs
target: OWASP Juice Shop session/JWT handling on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Fix logout handlers, issue exp/jti claims, and reject tokens after logout through denylisting or short-lived access tokens with refresh-token revocation.

finding: Deleted Account JWT Remains Valid on Protected APIs
target: OWASP Juice Shop JWT authorization on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: On every protected request, validate that the token subject still exists and is active, and revoke tokens on account deletion.

finding: Weak Default Admin Password
target: OWASP Juice Shop admin account on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Rotate the admin password to a strong unique value, store it with a slow password hash, and enable MFA/rate limiting.

finding: Inactive accounts can authenticate and access protected APIs
target: OWASP Juice Shop API on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Reject logins and authenticated requests for inactive or deleted users, and prevent clients from setting isActive during registration.

finding: Server-issued JWTs are accepted without expiration claims
target: OWASP Juice Shop API on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Add short expirations to all JWTs, reject tokens missing exp, and pair with refresh-token rotation/revocation for long-lived sessions.

finding: Mass Assignment Creates Persistent Admin Accounts
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Apply a strict allowlist on registration fields and set role/status fields server-side only.

finding: Broken Object Level Authorization Allows Customer to Read Admin User Record
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Check that the requested user ID matches the authenticated subject unless the requester is an admin.

finding: JWTs Remain Valid After Logout
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Fix logout routes and use short-lived tokens plus server-side revocation/denylisting for logout and account state changes.

finding: Deleted Account JWT Remains Accepted by Protected APIs
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Validate JWT subject existence and active state during authorization and revoke tokens when accounts are deleted.

finding: Exposed Premium Key Allows Replay Upgrade to Deluxe Membership
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Remove public access to premium.key and verify payments server-side with one-time, user-bound tokens.

finding: Inactive Accounts Can Authenticate and Use Protected APIs
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Do not accept isActive from clients and deny login/API access for inactive accounts.

finding: Unauthenticated recovery endpoint leaks account existence and security questions
target: OWASP Juice Shop API on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Do not expose recovery questions or existence state; use uniform responses and out-of-band reset flows with rate limiting.

finding: SQL Injection Authentication Bypass Mints Admin JWT
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Replace concatenated login SQL with parameterized ORM/prepared statements and enforce password verification before issuing JWTs.

finding: Unsigned JWT alg=none Accepted for Administrator Authorization
target: OWASP Juice Shop JWT middleware on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Upgrade JWT libraries and configure verification to allow only the expected asymmetric algorithm, rejecting alg=none and unsigned tokens.

finding: JWT RS256-to-HS256 Algorithm Confusion Using Exposed Public Key
target: OWASP Juice Shop JWT middleware on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Pin JWT verification to RS256, reject symmetric algorithms for RSA-key tokens, rotate keys, and remove unnecessary public key exposure.

finding: Broken Object Level Authorization Allows Customer to Read Admin User Record
target: OWASP Juice Shop REST API on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Add per-object authorization checks so non-admin users can only access their own user record and redact sensitive fields.

finding: Registration mass assignment permits arbitrary role selection
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.20:3000 REST API
remediation: Use DTO/field allowlisting during registration and set role/privilege fields exclusively server-side.

finding: JWT session tokens expose sensitive account fields and never expire
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.20:3000 authentication/session layer
remediation: Minimize JWT claims to subject/role/session identifiers, add short exp/nbf/aud/iss claims, and keep secrets server-side only.

finding: SQL Injection Authentication Bypass in Juice Shop Login
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Replace concatenated SQL in login with parameterized ORM queries/prepared statements and verify passwords server-side before issuing tokens.

finding: JWT Algorithm Confusion Allows Forged Admin Tokens
target: OWASP Juice Shop JWT-protected API on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Pin accepted JWT algorithms to RS256, reject alg=none, never use asymmetric public keys as HMAC secrets, rotate keys, and upgrade express-jwt/jsonwebtoken.

finding: Unauthenticated Exposure of Premium Membership Secret
target: OWASP Juice Shop static encryption key endpoint on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Remove encryption keys from public web paths, rotate the premium key, and store secrets in a server-side secret manager.

finding: JWT alg=none signature bypass accepted for admin tokens
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 on Express/Node.js JWT authentication:3000
remediation: Pin accepted JWT algorithms to RS256, require a valid signature, and reject alg=none tokens in all authentication middleware.

finding: JWT RS256-to-HS256 algorithm confusion using exposed RSA public key
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 on Express/Node.js JWT authentication:3000
remediation: Pin JWT verification to RS256 only and prevent HS* algorithms from using RSA public key material as an HMAC secret.

finding: Server-issued JWTs have no expiration claim
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 on Express/Node.js JWT authentication:3000
remediation: Add short-lived exp claims to all access tokens and enforce expiration, issuer, and audience during verification.

finding: Cryptographic premium membership key exposed over HTTP
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 static encryption key distribution:3000
remediation: Remove secret key material from the web root and rotate the exposed premium key immediately.

finding: JWT signature verification bypass via alg=none and RS256-to-HS256 confusion
target: OWASP Juice Shop / Node.js express-jwt JWT authorization:3000
remediation: Pin the JWT algorithm to RS256 only, reject alg=none, segregate RSA and HMAC key handling, rotate tokens, and upgrade legacy JWT middleware.

finding: Server-issued JWTs expose sensitive account data and omit expiry
target: OWASP Juice Shop JWT authentication:3000
remediation: Issue short-lived JWTs containing only minimal non-sensitive claims; store sensitive attributes server-side and enforce token expiration/revocation.

finding: Public /encryptionkeys directory exposes JWT public key and premium key secret
target: OWASP Juice Shop static file serving:3000
remediation: Remove key material from the web root, disable directory indexing, restrict static file serving, and rotate exposed secrets/tokens.

finding: SQL Injection Authentication Bypass Mints Admin JWT
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Parameterize the login query, validate email syntax, and add regression tests for SQL metacharacters in authentication fields.

finding: Unsigned alg=none JWT Accepted for Administrator Authorization
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Disable alg=none, pin the expected JWT algorithm server-side, and reject unsigned tokens regardless of header claims.

finding: JWT RS256-to-HS256 Algorithm Confusion Using Exposed Public Key
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Pin RS256 verification, reject HS256 for RSA-backed tokens, and avoid exposing verification keys unless all JWT libraries are configured safely.

finding: Product Search SQL Injection Discloses Product Table Data
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Use parameterized queries/ORM bind variables for product search and add SQLi regression tests for q.

finding: Basket IDOR Allows Cross-Account Basket Read
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Enforce object ownership checks on /rest/basket/{id}; derive basket ID from the authenticated user where possible instead of trusting path parameters.

finding: Unauthenticated Security Question Endpoint Enables Account Enumeration and Recovery Question Disclosure
target: OWASP Juice Shop v14.5.1 password recovery API:3000
remediation: Return generic responses for recovery lookups, rate-limit attempts, and require an out-of-band recovery flow before revealing any challenge.

finding: Inactive Accounts Can Authenticate and Use Protected APIs
target: OWASP Juice Shop v14.5.1 user authentication and /api/Users:3000
remediation: Reject inactive/deleted users during login and re-check current user status in authorization middleware for every request.

finding: FTP Null-Byte Extension Filter Bypass Exposes package.json.bak
target: OWASP Juice Shop v14.5.1 static FTP file handler:3000
remediation: Normalize and decode paths once, reject null bytes/encoded nulls, and enforce extension allowlists on the canonical basename before serving files.

finding: Password change accepts wrong current password via parameter confusion
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.20:3000 account management
remediation: Use one canonical current-password parameter, verify it server-side before any update, reject query-string password changes, and invalidate sessions after password reset.

finding: Unauthenticated ChromaDB API exposes collection metadata and documents
target: ChromaDB 0.5.18 / uvicorn API:8001
remediation: Restrict ChromaDB to trusted networks, add authentication/authorization at the service or reverse proxy, and rotate any exposed sensitive data.

finding: JWT alg=none authentication bypass from vulnerable express-jwt/Juice Shop advisory
target: OWASP Juice Shop on Express / express-jwt 0.1.3
remediation: Pin accepted JWT algorithms to RS256, reject alg=none, and upgrade express-jwt/jsonwebtoken to patched versions.

finding: Publicly exposed cryptographic/payment key material
target: OWASP Juice Shop static /encryptionkeys route:3000
remediation: Remove public static access to key material, rotate premium/JWT secrets, and store secrets in a server-side secret manager.

finding: SQL Injection Authentication Bypass in Login
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Express login API:3000
remediation: Use parameterized queries/ORM predicates for authentication and reject SQL metacharacter payloads at validation boundaries.

finding: JWT alg=none Admin Token Forgery
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Express JWT authentication:3000
remediation: Pin accepted JWT algorithms server-side and reject unsigned tokens regardless of token header value.

finding: JWT HS/RS Algorithm Confusion via Exposed RSA Public Key
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Express JWT authentication:3000
remediation: Pin RS256 only, use separate verification paths for asymmetric and symmetric keys, and remove public key material from web-exposed paths where not explicitly required.

finding: Server-Issued JWTs Have No Expiration
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / JWT session management:3000
remediation: Add short exp/nbf claims, enforce them during verification, and rotate signing keys after compromise.

finding: Mass Assignment Allows Self-Registration as Admin
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / User registration API:3000
remediation: Whitelist assignable registration fields and set role server-side to the least-privileged default.

finding: Authenticated IDOR/BOLA on User Object Endpoint
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / User API:3000
remediation: Enforce per-object authorization: only the subject user or an authorized admin role may access a user object.

finding: Unauthenticated Account Recovery Question Disclosure and Account Enumeration
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Account recovery API:3000
remediation: Return uniform responses for recovery initiation, require anti-automation controls, and disclose recovery prompts only after verified user interaction.

finding: Unauthenticated Administrative Application Configuration Disclosure
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Admin configuration API:3000
remediation: Require admin authorization for configuration endpoints and redact deployment-sensitive settings.

finding: Unauthenticated Exposure of Premium HMAC Key
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / encryptionkeys static artifact exposure:3000
remediation: Remove encryption key directories from web routing, rotate exposed keys, and store secrets in a protected secret manager or environment variable.

finding: Unauthenticated ChromaDB API exposes internal collection contents
target: ChromaDB 0.5.18 / FastAPI Uvicorn:8001
remediation: Require ChromaDB authentication, restrict 8001 to trusted management hosts, and disable public OpenAPI/docs exposure.

finding: Login endpoint lacks rate limiting or account lockout
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.20:3000 authentication layer
remediation: Enforce per-account and per-source rate limits, exponential backoff, alerting, and temporary lockout after repeated failed logins.

finding: Null-byte extension filter bypass exposes backup/source artifacts
target: OWASP Juice Shop /ftp file server:3000
remediation: Canonicalize and fully decode filenames before extension checks; reject null bytes and remove sensitive backup files from the public FTP directory.

finding: Weak custom RSA-style encryption and exposed bytecode allow encrypted announcement recovery
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 /ftp static artifact exposure:3000
remediation: Remove sensitive crypto implementation artifacts from public /ftp, fix the null-byte extension bypass, and replace deterministic per-character encryption with standard authenticated encryption.

finding: SQL Injection Authentication Bypass in Login
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Express login API:3000
remediation: Parameterize the login query and ensure authentication failure is indistinguishable for invalid credentials.

finding: Negative Basket Item Quantity Accepted and Persisted
target: OWASP Juice Shop v14.5.1 basket item API:3000
remediation: Enforce quantity as an integer range 1..5 server-side and recalculate checkout totals from canonical server data.

finding: JWT alg=none Signature Bypass
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 JWT authorization middleware:3000
remediation: Pin JWT verification to RS256 and reject unsigned tokens regardless of the alg header value.

finding: JWT RS256-to-HS256 Public-Key Confusion
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 JWT authorization middleware:3000
remediation: Pin accepted JWT algorithms to RS256 only and do not pass RSA public keys into code paths that accept HMAC algorithms.

finding: Customer Token Can Dump Bulk User and Authentication Details
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 user APIs:3000
remediation: Restrict bulk user/authentication-detail endpoints to administrator role and return only the caller’s own record to customers.

finding: User Record BOLA/IDOR via /api/Users/{id}
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 user API:3000
remediation: Apply object-level authorization checks so customers can only access their own user id unless they are administrators.

finding: Basket BOLA/IDOR via /rest/basket/{id}
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 basket API:3000
remediation: Check that the authenticated user owns the requested basket before returning basket data.

finding: Unauthenticated Security Question Enumeration
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 password reset/security question API:3000
remediation: Require a verified reset step and make valid/invalid account responses indistinguishable with rate limiting.

finding: Server-Issued JWTs Lack Expiration Claim
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 JWT session handling:3000
remediation: Add short-lived exp claims, validate them on every request, and support refresh-token rotation/revocation.

finding: JWT verification bypass via alg=none and RS256-to-HS256 public-key confusion
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.20:3000; express-jwt 0.1.3/jsonwebtoken dependency evidence in leaked package artifacts
remediation: Pin accepted JWT algorithms to RS256, reject alg=none, upgrade JWT middleware, and remove public access to signing/verification key material where not explicitly required.

finding: SQL injection authentication bypass returns admin JWT
target: OWASP Juice Shop login API on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Replace string-built SQL with parameterized queries/ORM where clauses and add input validation plus regression tests for quote/comment payloads.

finding: SQL injection in product search endpoint
target: OWASP Juice Shop product search API on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Parameterize the server-side product search query and avoid concatenating q into SQL.

finding: Exposed hardcoded premium membership key enables unauthorized role upgrade
target: OWASP Juice Shop encryptionkeys/deluxe-membership APIs on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Remove public access to premium.key and replace static token checks with server-side payment-provider verification bound to the authenticated user and transaction.

finding: Unauthenticated ChromaDB allows arbitrary collection writes and vector-store tampering
target: ChromaDB 0.5.18 / uvicorn:8001
remediation: Restrict network exposure and require authentication before any ChromaDB read/write API access.

finding: Unauthenticated ChromaDB write access enables vector-store poisoning
target: ChromaDB 0.5.18 / uvicorn API:8001
remediation: Bind ChromaDB to localhost or a trusted management network, require authentication and authorization for write endpoints, and review/remove unauthorized documents.

finding: SQL Injection Authentication Bypass Mints Admin JWT
target: OWASP Juice Shop / Node.js Express auth API:3000
remediation: Replace string-built login queries with parameterized ORM queries and verify the supplied password before issuing JWTs.

finding: Unauthenticated Registration Mass Assignment Creates Admin Accounts
target: OWASP Juice Shop v14.5.1 user registration API:3000
remediation: Apply server-side DTO/field allowlisting on registration and force role/customer-only defaults for all privilege-bearing fields.

finding: Public registration mass assignment creates administrator accounts
target: OWASP Juice Shop REST API /api/Users/:3000
remediation: Use a strict server-side allowlist for registration fields and set role/isActive/deluxeToken exclusively on the server.

finding: Product search UNION SQL injection exfiltrates user records
target: OWASP Juice Shop /rest/products/search:3000
remediation: Replace string-built search SQL with ORM/parameterized queries and apply input length/type validation.

finding: Cross-account basket read IDOR/BOLA
target: OWASP Juice Shop /rest/basket/{id}:3000
remediation: Check that req.user owns the requested BasketId before returning basket contents.

finding: Inactive accounts can authenticate and use protected APIs
target: OWASP Juice Shop authentication / user status checks:3000
remediation: Check isActive=false at login and on every authenticated request, and revoke existing tokens for disabled users.

finding: JWTs leak password hash and entitlement token and have no expiry
target: OWASP Juice Shop JWT issuance:3000
remediation: Issue minimal, short-lived JWTs and never include password hashes, TOTP secrets, or entitlement tokens as claims.

finding: Password change accepts wrong current password
target: OWASP Juice Shop /rest/user/change-password:3000
remediation: Require and verify the correct current password server-side before updating credentials; do not accept password changes through query parameters.

finding: Negative basket quantities accepted and persisted
target: OWASP Juice Shop /api/BasketItems/:3000
remediation: Enforce positive integer quantity bounds on create/update and recompute totals server-side.

finding: Unauthenticated security-question disclosure enables account recovery targeting
target: OWASP Juice Shop /rest/user/security-question:3000
remediation: Do not expose security questions unauthenticated; use uniform responses, rate limiting, and out-of-band reset tokens.

finding: Password Change Does Not Validate Current Password
target: OWASP Juice Shop v14.5.1 password change API:3000
remediation: Require and verify the actual current password before changing credentials, and revoke existing tokens after password changes.

finding: Lateral credential reuse grants admin access to peer Juice Shop host
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.21
remediation: Rotate reused credentials and enforce unique, non-default admin passwords across hosts.

finding: Unsigned JWT accepted on lateral peer Juice Shop instance
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.21
remediation: Disable unsigned JWTs and enforce strict signature verification with an algorithm allowlist.

finding: Internal ChromaDB API exposed without authentication via lateral topology disclosure
target: ChromaDB 0.5.18 / Uvicorn on 10.10.0.1
remediation: Restrict ChromaDB network exposure and require authentication for all collection read APIs.

finding: JWT Verification Bypass via alg=none
target: OWASP Juice Shop / Node.js Express JWT auth:3000
remediation: Configure JWT verification to allow only the intended asymmetric algorithm (RS256) and reject unsigned tokens.

finding: JWT RS256-to-HS256 Algorithm Confusion with Exposed Public Key
target: OWASP Juice Shop / Node.js Express JWT auth:3000
remediation: Pin JWT algorithms to RS256, separate symmetric/asymmetric key material, and remove public key directory listing from the web root.

finding: Server-Issued JWTs Expose Sensitive Account Fields and Do Not Expire
target: OWASP Juice Shop / Node.js Express JWT auth:3000
remediation: Minimize JWT claims to non-sensitive identifiers and add short expiration with refresh-token rotation.

finding: Unauthenticated Chromium Renderer Exposes Internal Browser SSRF Primitive
target: chromium_renderer HTTP API:3301
remediation: Require authentication on renderer APIs and enforce a strict URL allowlist blocking file:, data:, loopback, RFC1918, and metadata addresses.

finding: Unauthenticated ChromaDB Allows RAG Collection Read/Write Poisoning
target: ChromaDB 0.5.18 HTTP API:8001
remediation: Remove public exposure of ChromaDB, require token authentication, and isolate it on an internal network with least-privilege write access.

finding: JWT alg=none authentication bypass permits forged admin tokens
target: OWASP Juice Shop Express API:3000
remediation: Configure JWT verification with a strict algorithm allowlist, reject alg=none, and add regression tests proving unsigned tokens are denied.

finding: JWT RS256-to-HS256 algorithm confusion using exposed RSA public key
target: OWASP Juice Shop Express API:3000
remediation: Pin accepted JWT algorithms to RS256 only, ensure HMAC algorithms are disabled for RSA-backed tokens, and keep verification keys out of web-accessible directories.

finding: Broken Object-Level Authorization Allows Cross-Account User Record Reads
target: OWASP Juice Shop / Node.js Express REST API:3000
remediation: Apply per-object authorization so users can access only their own record unless explicitly authorized as an administrator.

finding: Authenticated Password Change Does Not Verify Current Password
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Password change API:3000
remediation: Require the verified current password before changing credentials and use a single unambiguous currentPassword parameter.

finding: Customer Role Can Access Bulk User and Authentication Detail APIs
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / User and authentication-details APIs:3000
remediation: Enforce role-based authorization on bulk account endpoints and redact sensitive account fields from API responses.

finding: Basket Object IDOR/BOLA Allows Cross-Account Basket Reads
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Basket API:3000
remediation: Authorize basket access by comparing the requested basket owner to the authenticated user, except for explicitly privileged admin workflows.

finding: Unauthenticated ChromaDB 0.5.18 Allows Collection Enumeration and Document Write/Read
target: ChromaDB 0.5.18 / uvicorn API:8001
remediation: Restrict ChromaDB to trusted backend networks, add authentication/authorization at a proxy or gateway, and audit/clean poisoned collections.

finding: JWT Payload Discloses Password Hash, deluxeToken, and TOTP Secret Field
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / JWT session management:3000
remediation: Minimize JWT claims to non-sensitive identity/authorization attributes and rotate any secrets exposed in issued tokens.

finding: FTP Extension Filter Bypass Exposes Backup and Bytecode Artifacts
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / FTP static file area:3000
remediation: Normalize and validate paths after full URL decoding, disable directory indexing, and remove backup/bytecode/secret artifacts from public file roots.

finding: JWT not-before claim ignored for otherwise valid forged tokens
target: OWASP Juice Shop / Node.js JWT auth on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Pin JWT algorithms and ensure the verifier enforces nbf and exp claims; reject tokens that are not yet active.

finding: Low-Privileged Users Can Retrieve All Users' Authentication Metadata
target: OWASP Juice Shop v14.5.1 authentication-details API:3000
remediation: Require admin authorization for all-user authentication metadata and remove secrets/totp/internal URL fields from nonessential responses.

finding: Unauthenticated Registration Mass Assignment to Administrator
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 user registration API:3000
remediation: Use a strict allowlist for registration fields and force role=customer server-side for self-service account creation.

finding: Sensitive Account Data Embedded in Client-Readable JWT Claims
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 JWT session handling:3000
remediation: Issue JWTs with minimal claims only; never embed password hashes, secrets, or full user records in bearer tokens.

finding: JWT nbf claim is ignored on protected API authorization
target: OWASP Juice Shop / Node.js JWT authorization:3000
remediation: Configure JWT verification to enforce nbf and exp, reject tokens that are not yet valid, and keep algorithm pinning to RS256.

finding: JWT Sessions Not Revoked After Password Change
target: OWASP Juice Shop v14.5.1 JWT session handling:3000
remediation: Invalidate existing JWTs on password change by enforcing token version/passwordChangedAt checks and issuing short-lived tokens.

finding: Unauthenticated chromium_renderer URL rendering enables internal network SSRF pivot
target: genesis-chromium_renderer HTTP service:3301
remediation: Require authentication, enforce strict destination allowlists, block RFC1918/link-local egress from the renderer, and return minimal metadata only.

finding: Unauthenticated User Registration Mass-Assignment Grants Administrator Role
target: OWASP Juice Shop / Node.js Express user API:3000
remediation: Use server-side field allow-lists for registration and assign the default customer role regardless of client input.

finding: Unauthenticated Registration Mass Assignment Creates Administrator Accounts
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Use server-side field allowlists on registration and assign role exclusively on the server.

finding: Authenticated Password Change Does Not Verify Current Password
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Require and verify the current password using a constant-time password hash comparison before updating credentials.

finding: User Profile BOLA Allows Low-Privileged Read of Administrator Profile
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Enforce object-level authorization on every /api/Users/{id} request; customers may access only their own user object.

finding: Exposed premium.key Enables Deluxe Membership Token Replay
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Remove secret keys from web-accessible paths and verify membership upgrades through a server-side payment provider.

finding: XML External Entity Expansion in File Upload Reads Local Files
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Disable DTD/external entity resolution for XML parsers, block file/network entity access, and avoid reflecting parsed XML in errors.

finding: FTP Poison-Null-Byte Bypass Exposes Backup package.json
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Reject null-byte encodings, canonicalize paths before authorization, and serve only explicit allowlisted public files.

finding: Boolean-Blind SQL Injection Extracts TOTP Secret from Product Search
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Parameterize product search queries and segregate database privileges so product search cannot read user authentication secrets.

finding: Unauthenticated Security Question Endpoint Enables Account Enumeration and Recovery Hint Disclosure
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Return indistinguishable responses for existing/nonexistent accounts, rate limit recovery probes, and reveal recovery questions only after stronger verification.

finding: Server-Issued JWTs Leak Sensitive Account Fields and Omit Expiration
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Issue minimal JWT claims, remove secrets/hashes from token payloads, add short expiration, and rotate signing keys/tokens after fixing.

finding: Unauthenticated ChromaDB collection read on internal host
target: ChromaDB/Uvicorn HTTP API on 10.10.0.1
remediation: Require authentication/authorization for ChromaDB and restrict tcp/8001 to trusted application hosts only.

finding: Unauthenticated Mass Assignment Creates Administrator Accounts
target: OWASP Juice Shop user registration API on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Use a registration-field allow-list and assign role server-side; reject or ignore privilege fields in client JSON.

finding: Product Search SQL Injection Enables Boolean-Blind TOTP Secret Extraction
target: OWASP Juice Shop product search on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Parameterize search queries, escape LIKE metacharacters, and deny database error disclosure; rotate exposed TOTP secrets.

remediation: Use explicit server-side field allowlists and assign roles only on trusted administrative code paths.

finding: SQL injection authentication bypass on login
target: OWASP Juice Shop login API on 10.10.0.20:3000

finding: Server-issued JWTs expose sensitive claims and lack expiration
target: OWASP Juice Shop JWT session handling on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Minimize JWT claims to non-sensitive identifiers, add short expiration and issuer/audience validation, and rotate exposed tokens.

finding: Cross-account basket BOLA/IDOR
target: OWASP Juice Shop basket API on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Add object-level authorization checks binding basket IDs to the authenticated user on all basket routes.

finding: Password change is performed over GET with credentials in URL and hash disclosure
target: OWASP Juice Shop 6.2.0-SNAPSHOT / Node.js Express auth API:3000
remediation: Move password changes to POST/PATCH with CSRF protection, accept secrets only in the request body, disable caching, and return no password hash or full user object.

finding: Public FTP path bypass exposes dependency backup and KeePass database
target: OWASP Juice Shop static /ftp file server on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Remove sensitive files from the public FTP directory and validate canonical decoded filenames/extensions before serving downloads.

finding: JWT alg=none authentication bypass grants administrator API access
target: OWASP Juice Shop JWT authentication on Express/Node.js:3000
remediation: Pin accepted JWT algorithms to the expected asymmetric algorithm, reject alg=none/unsecured tokens, and upgrade JWT middleware to a current version.

finding: JWT RS256-to-HS256 algorithm confusion using exposed RSA public key
target: OWASP Juice Shop JWT authentication on Express/Node.js:3000
remediation: Pin JWT verification to RS256 only, separate symmetric/asymmetric key paths, and prevent public-key material from being used as an HMAC secret.

finding: JWT contains password hash and sensitive account metadata
target: OWASP Juice Shop 6.2.0-SNAPSHOT / JWT authentication:3000
remediation: Use minimal JWT claims and exclude password hashes, TOTP secrets, premium tokens, IP addresses, and full ORM records from token payloads.

finding: Unauthenticated exposure of JWT RSA public key enables token forgery chain
target: OWASP Juice Shop static encryption key endpoint:3000
remediation: Do not serve key directories from the web root; keep verification/signing material in server-only secret storage and fix JWT algorithm validation.

finding: Unauthenticated Mass Assignment Creates Administrator Accounts
target: OWASP Juice Shop user registration API:3000
remediation: Use an allow-list DTO for registration fields and assign roles only in trusted server-side administrative workflows.

finding: Cross-account basket item deletion BOLA/IDOR
target: OWASP Juice Shop BasketItems API on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Enforce ownership checks through the parent basket/user relationship before updating or deleting basket items.

finding: Cross-account user record IDOR
target: OWASP Juice Shop Users API on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Require either self-access or admin privileges for user detail lookups and minimize returned user fields.

finding: Legacy express-jwt accepts unsigned alg=none administrator tokens
target: OWASP Juice Shop / express-jwt 0.1.3 on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Upgrade express-jwt/jsonwebtoken and enforce a strict JWT algorithm allow-list; reject alg=none tokens at the authentication middleware.

finding: Public FTP File Download Null-Byte Extension Bypass Exposes Backup Files
target: OWASP Juice Shop FTP download route:3000
remediation: Normalize and fully decode filenames before validation, reject null bytes, enforce an allow-list on the final canonical extension, and keep backups outside the public download directory.

finding: Broken object-level authorization exposes other users' shopping baskets
target: OWASP Juice Shop 6.2.0-SNAPSHOT / Node.js Express basket API:3000
remediation: Enforce basket ownership on /rest/basket/{id}; derive basket id from the authenticated principal where possible instead of trusting path parameters.

finding: JWT verification bypass via RS256-to-HS256 algorithm confusion
target: OWASP Juice Shop JWT authentication API:3000
remediation: Pin accepted JWT algorithms server-side, reject HS* and none tokens, and do not expose or reuse asymmetric public keys as HMAC secrets.

finding: JWT accepts unsigned alg=none administrator tokens
target: OWASP Juice Shop JWT authentication API:3000
remediation: Disable unsigned JWTs, pin algorithms to RS256 or the intended algorithm, and upgrade JWT middleware to a maintained version.

finding: SQL injection authentication bypass in /rest/user/login
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Express API:3000
remediation: Replace dynamic SQL with parameterized queries/ORM predicates and add negative tests for SQL metacharacters in authentication fields.

finding: SQL injection in product search allows query manipulation
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Express API:3000
remediation: Use parameterized SQL/ORM search APIs and escape LIKE wildcards before constructing search predicates.

finding: JWT alg=none administrator token accepted
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / JWT authorization middleware:3000
remediation: Pin JWT verification to RS256, reject alg=none, and require a valid signature on every bearer token.

finding: RS256-to-HS256 JWT algorithm confusion using exposed public key
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / JWT authorization middleware:3000
remediation: Pin the expected JWT algorithm server-side and never reuse asymmetric public keys as HMAC secrets.

finding: Self-registration mass assignment grants administrator role
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / User registration API:3000
remediation: Use server-side allow-lists for registration fields and assign roles only in privileged administrative workflows.

finding: Password reset knowledge-answer takeover for admin account
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Password reset API:3000
remediation: Remove knowledge-based password resets; use rate-limited, expiring, single-use reset tokens and do not disclose account recovery metadata.

finding: Unauthenticated exposure of JWT public key and premium key
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Static encryptionkeys directory:3000
remediation: Move secrets and keys out of the web root, rotate exposed keys/tokens, and load them from a secret manager or protected environment variables.

finding: FTP extension filter bypass exposes backup artifacts
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / FTP file server:3000
remediation: Canonicalize paths before extension checks, reject encoded null bytes/double-encoded separators, and remove backup files from served directories.

finding: Unauthenticated administrative application configuration disclosure
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Admin REST API:3000
remediation: Protect administrative metadata endpoints with authentication and server-side role checks; return only non-sensitive public configuration to anonymous clients.

finding: Server-issued JWTs expose password hashes and lack expiration
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / JWT session tokens:3000
remediation: Do not place password hashes or profile secrets in JWT claims; issue short-lived tokens with exp/iss/aud and rotate signing keys after exposure.

finding: Unauthenticated ChromaDB write enables persistent vector-store/RAG poisoning
target: ChromaDB HTTP API / Uvicorn:8001
remediation: Place ChromaDB behind authenticated access control, restrict port 8001 to trusted control-plane hosts, and audit/remove untrusted collections/documents.

finding: JWT alg=none Bypass Allows Unsigned Administrator Tokens
target: OWASP Juice Shop JWT authentication:3000
remediation: Upgrade JWT middleware, pin accepted algorithms to RS256, and reject unsigned tokens regardless of claims.

finding: Exposed JWT Public Key Enables RS256-to-HS256 Admin Token Forgery
target: OWASP Juice Shop on Express/Node.js:3000
remediation: Restrict accepted JWT algorithms to RS256 only, never use public keys as HMAC secrets, rotate signing keys, and remove /encryptionkeys from public static routes.

finding: FTP Backup Extension Filter Bypass via Double-Encoded Null Byte
target: OWASP Juice Shop /ftp static file endpoint:3000
remediation: Normalize and decode filenames before validation, reject null-byte encodings, enforce an allowlist after canonicalization, and move sensitive backups outside the web root.

finding: Exposed Premium License/Deluxe Key
target: OWASP Juice Shop static encryption key endpoint:3000
remediation: Remove premium.key from public static routes, rotate the exposed key, and store license/entitlement keys only in server-side secret storage.

finding: JWT signature verification bypass via alg=none and RS256-to-HS256 confusion
target: OWASP Juice Shop 6.2.0-SNAPSHOT / express-jwt/jsonwebtoken:3000
remediation: Pin JWT verification to RS256 only, reject alg=none/HS* tokens, rotate signing keys, and stop exposing verification keys from public web paths unless JWKS is strictly configured.

finding: SQL injection authentication bypass returns administrator JWT
target: OWASP Juice Shop 6.2.0-SNAPSHOT login API:3000
remediation: Replace string-built login SQL with parameterized ORM queries/prepared statements and add regression tests for quote/comment payloads.

finding: Unauthenticated role mass assignment creates administrator accounts
target: OWASP Juice Shop 6.2.0-SNAPSHOT user registration API:3000
remediation: Use strict server-side field allowlists for registration and assign roles only in trusted administrative workflows.

finding: Broken object-level authorization exposes all user records to low-privilege users
target: OWASP Juice Shop 6.2.0-SNAPSHOT users API:3000
remediation: Apply per-object authorization checks and restrict user listing endpoints to administrators only.

finding: Client-visible JWT embeds sensitive user-record fields
target: OWASP Juice Shop 6.2.0-SNAPSHOT JWT session handling:3000
remediation: Reduce JWTs to minimal non-sensitive claims and rotate any exposed secrets or premium tokens.

finding: Unauthenticated security-question endpoint enables account enumeration and reset targeting
target: OWASP Juice Shop 6.2.0-SNAPSHOT password reset/security question API:3000
remediation: Make account discovery responses indistinguishable, rate-limit requests, and avoid exposing security questions until after an out-of-band verification step.

finding: JWT algorithm confusion allows unauthenticated admin token forgery
target: OWASP Juice Shop 6.2.0-SNAPSHOT / Node express-jwt/jsonwebtoken stack:3000
remediation: Pin JWT verification to RS256 only, reject HS256/none tokens, rotate keys, and remove unauthenticated key disclosure if not required.

finding: Product search UNION SQL injection leaks Users credentials
target: OWASP Juice Shop 6.2.0-SNAPSHOT product search API:3000
remediation: Replace string-concatenated SQL with parameterized queries/replacements and add regression tests for UNION/error-based SQLi payloads.

finding: Full user collection exposed to any authenticated customer
target: OWASP Juice Shop Users API on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Require administrator role for collection-wide user listing and remove sensitive fields from API responses.

finding: Unauthenticated access to admin application configuration
target: OWASP Juice Shop admin REST API on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Protect admin configuration endpoints with admin authorization and redact sensitive config before returning it.

finding: FTP null-byte extension-filter bypass exposes restricted backup and bytecode artifacts
target: OWASP Juice Shop public FTP download route:3000
remediation: Canonicalize and repeatedly decode filenames before validation, reject null bytes and encoded nulls, enforce an allow-list on the final canonical extension, and keep backups/source artifacts outside the web root.

finding: JWT Payload Discloses Password Hash and Sensitive Account Metadata
target: OWASP Juice Shop JWT authentication:3000
remediation: Store only minimal non-sensitive authorization claims in JWTs and never include password hashes, secrets, tokens, or profile metadata.

finding: Deterministic per-character RSA encryption allows full plaintext recovery
target: OWASP Juice Shop FTP artifacts / custom encryption script:3000
remediation: Replace deterministic textbook RSA with authenticated hybrid encryption using OAEP/GCM and remove encrypted/plaintext artifacts from the public FTP area.

finding: Legacy coupon codes recoverable from exposed Z85-encoded backup
target: OWASP Juice Shop FTP backup artifacts:3000
remediation: Remove coupon backups from public storage, invalidate decoded coupons, and enforce server-side expiry/redemption checks.

finding: JWT authentication bypass via alg=none and RS256-to-HS256 confusion
target: OWASP Juice Shop 6.2.0-SNAPSHOT / express-jwt 0.1.3
remediation: Pin accepted JWT algorithms to RS256, reject alg=none, do not use asymmetric public keys as HMAC secrets, and upgrade JWT middleware.

finding: Encoded null-byte file filter bypass exposes restricted backup artifacts
target: OWASP Juice Shop FTP file serving route:3000
remediation: Canonicalize and decode file names before validation, reject null bytes, and enforce an allowlist of downloadable files.

finding: JWT accepted from plain token cookie on whoami endpoint
target: OWASP Juice Shop whoami session endpoint on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Use a single canonical JWT transport, reject ambient token cookies for bearer-token APIs, and if cookies are required set HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite and CSRF defenses.

finding: Broken Function-Level Authorization Exposes All Users to Customer Accounts
target: OWASP Juice Shop user API:3000
remediation: Enforce server-side role checks on /api/Users and return only the caller's own record to non-admin users.

finding: Missing role-based access control exposes full user collection to customers
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Users API:3000
remediation: Require administrator role on /api/Users and return least-privilege user projections; add authorization tests for customer tokens.

finding: Login lacks brute-force rate limiting or account lockout
target: OWASP Juice Shop login API on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Add per-IP and per-account rate limiting, exponential backoff, temporary lockout, and monitoring for repeated authentication failures.

finding: Unauthenticated ChromaDB 0.5.18 collection and document disclosure on internal hosts
remediation: Require authentication for ChromaDB, remove public/internal broad bind on 8001, and rotate any secrets or tokens stored in session_reflections.

finding: Unauthenticated role mass assignment creates administrator accounts
target: OWASP Juice Shop 6.2.0-SNAPSHOT user registration API:3000
remediation: Use server-side field allowlists, ignore role/profile privilege fields on public registration, and enforce authorization for privileged attributes.

finding: Exposed premium key enables unauthorized deluxe membership upgrade
target: OWASP Juice Shop encryptionkeys and deluxe membership API:3000

finding: Security question enumeration enables targeted account recovery attacks

remediation: Avoid exposing per-account recovery questions before identity proof; use generic responses, rate limiting, and tokenized out-of-band reset flows.

finding: JWT alg=none signature bypass permits forged admin tokens
target: OWASP Juice Shop 6.2.0-SNAPSHOT / express-jwt 0.1.3 on Node.js:3000
remediation: Upgrade JWT libraries and explicitly restrict accepted algorithms to the expected signed algorithm; never accept alg=none.

finding: JWT RS256-to-HS256 algorithm confusion using exposed public key
target: OWASP Juice Shop 6.2.0-SNAPSHOT / express-jwt 0.1.3 on Node.js:3000
remediation: Pin JWT verification algorithms, reject HS* tokens when using RSA keys, upgrade JWT middleware, and remove unnecessary public key exposure.

finding: Sensitive encryption key material exposed over HTTP
target: OWASP Juice Shop static encryption key endpoint:3000
remediation: Remove public access to /encryptionkeys and store keys/secrets in a secret manager or server-side environment only.

finding: UNION SQL injection in product search exfiltrates user credential hashes
target: OWASP Juice Shop product search API backed by SQLite:3000
remediation: Replace string-concatenated SQL with parameterized queries/ORM bind variables and restrict database privileges.

finding: JWT alg=none Authentication Bypass (CVE-2020-15084)
target: OWASP Juice Shop JWT authorization on Express/Node.js:3000
remediation: Pin accepted JWT algorithms server-side, reject alg=none tokens, and upgrade/remove vulnerable express-jwt/jsonwebtoken versions.

finding: UNION SQL Injection in Product Search Exfiltrates User Credentials
target: OWASP Juice Shop product search API:3000
remediation: Replace raw concatenated SQL in search with parameterized ORM queries or prepared statements and avoid returning SQL error details.

finding: JWT signature bypass via alg=none and RS256→HS256 algorithm confusion
target: OWASP Juice Shop 6.2.0-SNAPSHOT / express-jwt 0.1.3 on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Upgrade JWT libraries and explicitly allow only RS256 with an RSA public key; never derive accepted algorithms from the token header.

finding: Publicly exposed JWT verification key enables token forgery
target: OWASP Juice Shop 6.2.0-SNAPSHOT on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Remove /encryptionkeys from public routing and rotate JWT keys after patching algorithm allow-listing.

finding: JWT payload exposes sensitive account metadata and password hash
target: OWASP Juice Shop 6.2.0-SNAPSHOT on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Minimize JWT claims to non-sensitive identifiers and rotate exposed account secrets/hashes.

finding: SQL injection authentication bypass in login returns administrator JWT
target: OWASP Juice Shop login API backed by SQLite:3000
remediation: Use parameterized queries for login, validate email input, and compare password hashes only after retrieving a single user by bound email.

finding: Double-encoded null-byte FTP filter bypass discloses package metadata
target: OWASP Juice Shop 6.2.0-SNAPSHOT:3000
remediation: Canonicalize and strictly validate decoded filenames, reject NUL/%00 sequences, and do not expose backup artifacts under the web root.

finding: Unauthenticated registration mass assignment creates administrator users
target: OWASP Juice Shop user registration API:3000
remediation: Use an allow-list DTO for registration, ignore client-supplied role/admin fields, default all self-registered users to customer, and add tests for over-posting.

finding: Unauthenticated registration reveals existing email addresses
target: OWASP Juice Shop registration API on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Return generic, uniform registration responses for duplicate and new emails, and rate-limit registration attempts.

finding: Exposed premium key allows unpaid deluxe membership upgrade
target: OWASP Juice Shop deluxe membership / encryptionkeys:3000
remediation: Remove public access to entitlement keys and validate membership upgrades against a server-side payment provider/receipt, not a static client-supplied secret.

finding: Authentication bypass via SQL injection in login email field
target: OWASP Juice Shop 6.2.0-SNAPSHOT / Node.js Express login API:3000
remediation: Replace dynamic SQL/string-concatenated login queries with parameterized ORM queries and add regression tests for SQL metacharacters in email.

finding: JWT verifier accepts unsigned alg=none administrator tokens
target: OWASP Juice Shop 6.2.0-SNAPSHOT / express-jwt 0.1.3 / jsonwebtoken:3000
remediation: Explicitly restrict JWT verification to the intended signed algorithm and reject alg=none/case variants.

finding: RS256-to-HS256 JWT algorithm confusion using exposed public key
target: OWASP Juice Shop 6.2.0-SNAPSHOT / express-jwt 0.1.3 / jsonwebtoken:3000
remediation: Pin JWT algorithms to RS256 only, separate symmetric/asymmetric key handling, and remove public keys from browsable application paths if not needed.

finding: Unauthenticated mass assignment creates administrator accounts
target: OWASP Juice Shop 6.2.0-SNAPSHOT / User registration API:3000
remediation: Use server-side field allowlists and force role/customer status server-side during public registration.

finding: Customer JWT can read admin user objects and full user collection
target: OWASP Juice Shop 6.2.0-SNAPSHOT / User API authorization:3000
remediation: Require administrator role for user collection access and enforce ownership checks for individual user objects.

finding: Unauthenticated password-reset security question enumeration
target: OWASP Juice Shop 6.2.0-SNAPSHOT / Password reset API:3000
remediation: Return uniform responses for existing/non-existing accounts, avoid exposing reset questions pre-verification, and rate-limit/reset-monitor the endpoint.

finding: JWT payload exposes sensitive account metadata and password hash
target: OWASP Juice Shop 6.2.0-SNAPSHOT / JWT session handling:3000
remediation: Issue minimal short-lived JWTs containing only subject, role/scope, issuer/audience, and expiry; never embed password hashes or full user records.

finding: Password reset account takeover via enumerable security question and known answer
target: OWASP Juice Shop password reset API on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Remove security-question-only reset, use out-of-band single-use reset tokens, rate-limit attempts, and return generic responses without user records.

finding: Unauthenticated Security Question Disclosure Enables User Enumeration
target: OWASP Juice Shop password reset API:3000
remediation: Do not disclose reset questions by email lookup; use a generic response, rate limiting, and an out-of-band password reset flow.

finding: Exposed Premium Key Allows Unauthorized Deluxe Membership Upgrade
target: OWASP Juice Shop deluxe membership flow:3000

finding: Adjacent Juice Shop instance vulnerable to SQL injection authentication bypass
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.21
remediation: Parameterize authentication queries and validate email/password input; do not concatenate user-controlled login fields into SQL.

finding: Low-privileged customer token can read full users collection
target: OWASP Juice Shop users API:3000

finding: JWT signature bypass allows forged admin tokens
target: OWASP Juice Shop / Node.js JWT auth stack on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Pin JWT verification to a single expected algorithm, reject unsigned tokens, rotate signing keys, and invalidate existing tokens.

finding: Unauthenticated UNION SQL injection in product search
target: OWASP Juice Shop product search API on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Replace dynamic SQL concatenation with parameterized queries and add regression tests for quote/UNION payloads.

finding: Unauthenticated mass assignment creates administrator accounts
target: OWASP Juice Shop user registration API on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Use DTO/field allow-lists for registration and assign roles exclusively server-side.

finding: Public premium encryption key enables deluxe privilege upgrade
target: OWASP Juice Shop deluxe membership flow on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Remove exposed key files, rotate the premium key, and replace static-key upgrades with server-side payment verification.

finding: Persistent script-bearing product description served by public search API
target: OWASP Juice Shop product catalog on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Remove the stored payload, upgrade sanitize-html, sanitize product descriptions on write, and render untrusted descriptions as text.

finding: Arbitrary deluxe membership privilege upgrade
target: OWASP Juice Shop deluxe membership API on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Validate payment identifiers server-side with a trusted payment provider before changing roles; reject arbitrary client-supplied payment IDs.

finding: Password reset does not revoke existing JWT sessions
target: OWASP Juice Shop JWT session handling on 10.10.0.20:3000

finding: Adjacent Juice Shop accepts HS256 administrator JWTs signed with exposed RSA public key
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.21
remediation: Pin JWT verification to RS256 with the RSA public key, reject HS256/none tokens, and stop exposing verification keys if unnecessary.

finding: Unauthenticated Admin Configuration Disclosure

finding: Password reset response leaks password hash and account metadata
target: OWASP Juice Shop password reset API on 10.10.0.20:3000

finding: Server-issued JWTs omit expiration and expose sensitive account fields
target: OWASP Juice Shop JWT authentication on Express/Node.js:3000
remediation: Issue short-lived JWTs with exp/nbf/aud/iss and only minimal authorization claims; remove password hashes, TOTP secrets, and other sensitive fields from token payloads.

finding: Exposed raw RSA byte-at-a-time encryption allows full announcement plaintext recovery
target: OWASP Juice Shop exposed FTP artifacts /ftp/encrypt.pyc and /ftp/announcement_encrypted.md:3000

finding: Legacy coupon corpus recoverable via unauthenticated Z85 decoding

finding: Unauthenticated admin configuration endpoint leaks full application configuration

finding: Unsigned JWT alg=none tokens accepted for administrator access
target: OWASP Juice Shop 6.2.0-SNAPSHOT JWT authentication:3000

finding: Exposed weak RSA byte-at-a-time encryption is trivially decryptable
target: OWASP Juice Shop FTP artifacts:3000

finding: Exposed premium key grants unauthorized deluxe membership
target: OWASP Juice Shop 6.2.0-SNAPSHOT on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Remove premium.key from public web roots, rotate the premium key, and validate deluxe upgrades server-side with non-public payment proofs.

finding: Exposed KeePass vault uses dangerously weak KDF parameters
target: OWASP Juice Shop public FTP artifacts on 10.10.0.20:3000

finding: Unauthenticated admin configuration disclosure

finding: Unauthenticated role mass assignment creates admin users

finding: Unsigned alg=none JWT accepted for protected user API
target: OWASP Juice Shop 6.2.0-SNAPSHOT / express-jwt 0.1.3 JWT validation:3000
remediation: Upgrade JWT middleware and enforce an explicit algorithms allowlist that excludes none.

finding: JWT RS256-to-HS256 algorithm confusion using exposed public key
target: OWASP Juice Shop 6.2.0-SNAPSHOT / express-jwt 0.1.3 JWT validation:3000
remediation: Pin JWT verification to RS256 and upgrade JWT libraries; never allow symmetric algorithms for tokens intended to be verified with RSA keys.

finding: Broken object-level authorization on /api/Users/{id} exposes other users
target: OWASP Juice Shop 6.2.0-SNAPSHOT user API:3000

finding: JWT payload discloses password hashes and server-side account fields
target: OWASP Juice Shop 6.2.0-SNAPSHOT JWT session handling:3000
remediation: Minimize JWT claims to non-sensitive identifiers and fetch privileged account details server-side after authorization checks.

finding: Unauthenticated Redis exposes CONFIG SET, replication, Lua, and DEBUG primitives

finding: File extension filter bypass leaks protected backup artifacts
target: OWASP Juice Shop 6.2.0-SNAPSHOT FTP file server:3000

finding: Sequential user-object IDOR allows customers to read other users' profiles

finding: Sensitive data embedded in decodable JWT claims
target: OWASP Juice Shop 6.2.0-SNAPSHOT JWT authentication:3000

finding: Login SQL injection returns administrator JWT
target: OWASP Juice Shop 6.2.0-SNAPSHOT login API:3000

finding: Unauthenticated XXE local file disclosure in /file-upload
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 file upload endpoint:3000
remediation: Disable DTD and external entity resolution in XML parsing, reject XML with DOCTYPE/ENTITY declarations, and avoid reflecting parsed upload contents in errors.

finding: Restricted FTP static file filter bypass with encoded null byte
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 static /ftp file server:3000
remediation: Canonicalize and validate the decoded filename, reject null bytes, and serve only an explicit allow-list of safe files.

finding: Public exposure of incident-support KeePass database
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 static /ftp file server:3000
remediation: Remove sensitive support artifacts from publicly served directories and rotate any credentials contained in the vault.

finding: Verbose stack trace disclosure in redirect route
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 redirect route:3000
remediation: Validate required parameters before use and install a production error handler that does not disclose stack traces or filesystem paths.

finding: Stored XSS payload in product description exfiltrates JWTs
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 product catalog:3000
remediation: Sanitize stored product descriptions on write and render them as text or with a strict HTML allow-list; rotate tokens potentially stolen by the payload.

finding: Public non-production localization artifact exposed
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 static assets:3000
remediation: Exclude non-production localization files from production builds and serve only required language packs.

finding: UNION-based SQL injection in product search leaks SQLite schema and user credential fields
target: OWASP Juice Shop HTTP application:3000
remediation: Replace raw concatenated SQL with bound parameters/ORM predicates and add regression tests for quote/comment/UNION payloads.

finding: FTP file whitelist bypass via poison null-byte truncation
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 FTP file server route:3000
remediation: Reject encoded/null-byte sequences before extension validation and serve only canonical basename paths from an explicit allow-list.

finding: JWT alg=none accepted for administrator token forgery
target: OWASP Juice Shop on Express ^4.22.1 / express-jwt JWT middleware:3000
remediation: Upgrade express-jwt/jsonwebtoken and configure an explicit algorithm allow-list that excludes none.

finding: JWT RS256-to-HS256 algorithm confusion using exposed RSA public key
target: OWASP Juice Shop JWT authentication:3000
remediation: Pin JWT verification to RS256 only, reject HS* tokens on RSA-backed issuers, rotate keys, and avoid exposing verification keys in a way that can be reused as HMAC material.

finding: JWT not-before claim ignored when unsigned forged token is accepted
target: OWASP Juice Shop JWT authentication:3000
remediation: Enforce exp, iat, and nbf validation during JWT verification and reject unsigned tokens before claim processing.

finding: Hardcoded RSA private key enables valid RS256 administrator JWT forgery
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / JWT auth on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Rotate JWT signing keys immediately, remove hardcoded private keys from source/artifacts, and store secrets in a restricted secret manager.

finding: UNION SQL injection in product search exfiltrates user credentials
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Node.js Express Sequelize SQLite on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Replace raw string-concatenated SQL with parameterized queries and add regression tests for UNION/ORDER BY payloads.

finding: Unauthenticated ChromaDB exposes internal collections and live API key
target: ChromaDB 0.5.18 API
remediation: Enable ChromaDB authentication, restrict network access to trusted backend containers, and rotate any secrets stored in collection metadata.

finding: Authentication bypass via SQL injection in login email field
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Node.js Express login API:3000
remediation: Replace string-concatenated SQL in the login path with parameterized queries/ORM where clauses and add regression tests for SQLi login payloads.

finding: Unauthenticated XML external entity file disclosure in deprecated file upload
target: OWASP Juice Shop HTTP application:3000
remediation: Disable XML external entity resolution, prevent local/remote entity loading, and stop reflecting parsed XML in errors; remove the deprecated endpoint if possible.

finding: Login SQL Injection Enables Administrator Authentication Bypass
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 on HTTP port 3000
remediation: Replace string-concatenated SQL with ORM parameter binding/prepared statements and add regression tests for authentication-bypass payloads.

finding: Unauthenticated XXE in File Upload Reads Local Files
target: OWASP Juice Shop file-upload route on HTTP port 3000
remediation: Disable external entity expansion and DTD loading in XML parsing, reject DOCTYPE declarations, and require authentication/authorization for uploads.

finding: Public Encryption Key Directory Leaks Premium Secret
target: OWASP Juice Shop static encryptionkeys directory on HTTP port 3000
remediation: Remove public static serving of /encryptionkeys/, rotate the leaked premium key, and audit all exposed artifacts for secrets.

finding: SQL injection authentication bypass returns administrator JWT
target: OWASP Juice Shop authentication API:3000
remediation: Use ORM parameter binding/prepared statements for login lookup and never concatenate user-controlled email into SQL.

finding: JWT verifier accepts unsigned alg=none administrator tokens
target: OWASP Juice Shop JWT session middleware:3000
remediation: Pin the accepted JWT algorithm to RS256, reject alg=none, and never trust decoded claims before successful signature verification.

finding: JWT RS256-to-HS256 algorithm confusion using public jwt.pub
target: OWASP Juice Shop JWT session middleware + /encryptionkeys/jwt.pub:3000
remediation: Pin JWT verification to RS256 only, reject HS* algorithms for RSA keys, and stop exposing signing/verification key material through public static routes.

finding: JWT not-before claim ignored for accepted administrator tokens
target: OWASP Juice Shop JWT session middleware:3000
remediation: Enforce nbf and exp during JWT verification and reject tokens that are not currently valid.

finding: Unauthenticated mass assignment creates administrator account
target: OWASP Juice Shop Users API:3000
remediation: Apply server-side allowlists for writable fields and assign roles only in privileged administrative code paths.

finding: User account API lacks object-level authorization
target: OWASP Juice Shop Users API:3000
remediation: Enforce object ownership or administrator role on every /api/Users/{id} request.

finding: Basket API permits cross-account basket read with any customer JWT
target: OWASP Juice Shop Basket API:3000
remediation: Verify basket ownership or administrator role before returning /rest/basket/{id}.

finding: Password change does not require current password
target: OWASP Juice Shop password-change endpoint:3000
remediation: Require the current password or strong reauthentication before changing credentials.

finding: Password change does not invalidate existing JWT sessions
target: OWASP Juice Shop JWT session handling:3000
remediation: Track a per-user session/password version or token revocation timestamp and reject JWTs issued before credential changes.

finding: Server-issued JWT leaks MD5 password hash in payload
target: OWASP Juice Shop login/JWT issuance:3000
remediation: Remove password/password-hash fields from JWT claims and migrate password storage from MD5 to a slow salted KDF such as Argon2id or bcrypt.

finding: Passwordless administrator login via SQL injection in login email field
target: OWASP Juice Shop on http://10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Parameterize the login query, reject SQL metacharacter bypasses, and perform password verification against exactly one fetched user record.

finding: JWT signature verification bypass via alg=none and RSA-to-HMAC confusion
target: OWASP Juice Shop / express-jwt 0.1.3 on http://10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Upgrade JWT middleware, disable alg=none, pin RS256 only, and enforce asymmetric key-type validation.

finding: Cross-account user record disclosure via IDOR on /api/Users/{id}
target: OWASP Juice Shop API on http://10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Add object-level authorization: users may only read their own user object unless they have an authorized admin role.

finding: Sensitive account data exposed inside client-readable JWT payloads
target: OWASP Juice Shop JWT session handling on http://10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Reduce JWT payloads to minimal claims such as sub, role, iat, and exp; never embed password hashes, TOTP secrets, or database rows in client-side tokens.

finding: Login SQL injection enables administrator authentication bypass
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.20:3000
remediation: Parameterize the login query and avoid embedding full user records/password hashes in JWT payloads.

finding: The login handler is reachable at POST /rest/user/login and concatenates req.body.email into a raw SQL SELECT, allowing authentication bypass with email SQL injection.

Some protected REST API routes accept an unsigned alg=none JWT even though /rest/user/whoami did not populate the identity, enabling authentication bypass for /api/Users/{id}.
Server-issued login JWTs embed sensitive user database fields, including the password hash, in the client-visible JWT payload.

The public /ftp area exposes a KeePass credential database (incident-support.kdbx) without authentication.
The password-change endpoint trusts X-Forwarded-For: 127.0.0.1 and permits changing the authenticated user's password without supplying the current password.
The public /ftp area is served by Express serve-index and exposes additional downloadable artifacts beyond already-known package.json.bak.
The B2B v2 route family exposes auth and method handling that can be fingerprinted without credentials, while legacy B2B v1 paths are not currently mounted as route handlers.
GraphQL is not part of the exposed Juice Shop service surface.
The CSAF directory advertised in provider metadata exposes additional advisory JSON files or directory listing information.
Juice Shop still accepts login for the previously created low-privilege account and issues a bearer JWT suitable for auth/session tests.
Internal Redis at 172.18.0.9:6379 is reachable from the current vantage point and allows unauthenticated commands that may provide a pivot/RCE primitive.
JWT validation is misconfigured such that forged admin tokens using alg=none and/or HS256 signed with the exposed RSA public key are accepted on privileged user endpoints.
ChromaDB on 172.18.0.14 exposes unauthenticated collection metadata that can leak attack graph / knowledge-base data to any internal network client.
Authenticated non-admin users can access other users' account records by changing the numeric /api/Users/{id} path parameter (IDOR/BOLA).
Additional static directories such as /assets/public or /encryptionkeys may expose directory listings or further key/material files.
Public CSAF advisory JSON files reveal concrete dependency CVEs and vulnerable component details that exploit/code agents can map to the live service.
The listed /encryptionkeys/premium.key file is publicly readable and exposes cryptographic material used by premium/paywall features.
The 2024 CSAF advisory path is real but the exact file name or directory location differs from the index entry observed.
Internationalization/language resource directories are exposed and may disclose hidden or non-production language files.
Redirect-related service endpoints are exposed and can be fingerprinted without full exploitation.
Previously surfaced downloadable artifacts on 10.10.0.20:3000 contain source-level evidence of hardcoded secrets, weak crypto, or reachable injection/authentication sinks.

The source-level SQL string concatenation in routes/search.js is reachable via unauthenticated GET /rest/products/search?q= and allows at least error-based SQL injection, with UNION extraction possible using the known 9-column Products shape.
The public /ftp/incident-support.kdbx path exposes a KeePass password database crypto artifact that can be retrieved unauthenticated.

The /rest/user/login email field is SQL-injectable, allowing passwordless administrator authentication and issuance of a legitimate server-signed RS256 admin JWT containing the database password hash.
The login route contains a second reachable SQL injection in req.body.email that allows authentication bypass because email is concatenated before the password hash comparison.
JWT nbf (not-before) is not enforced when exp is still valid, permitting future-not-before forged tokens to authorize immediately.
JWT temporal claim enforcement is partial: exp is enforced, but nbf is ignored, allowing not-yet-valid tokens to authenticate.

Existing JWTs remain valid after a successful password reset when the security answer is registered through the SecurityAnswers API, because bearer tokens are stateless and not revoked on credential rotation.
CSAF sidecar files and change logs are publicly readable and may expose signatures, hashes, and advisory publication metadata.
Public static artifacts expose cache validators and support conditional/range requests, increasing risk of long-lived sensitive material caching.
The already-identified Juice Shop SQL injection in POST /rest/user/login is an end-to-end exploitable primitive that yields an administrator JWT and authorized access to /api/Users/1.
The JWT verifier on 10.10.0.20 accepts attacker-forged alg=none administrator tokens, giving protected API access without a signing key.
The JWT verifier on 10.10.0.20 is vulnerable to RS256-to-HS256 key confusion because it treats the exposed RSA public key bytes as an HMAC secret for HS256 tokens.
The live web service at http://10.10.0.20:3000 is an OWASP Juice Shop Node/Express Angular SPA rather than a traditional CMS.
The HTTP service is not protected by a recognizable WAF, enabling direct probing of Juice Shop application endpoints.
The target exposes plaintext HTTP only, with no usable TLS endpoint on 3000 or 443.
Responses include permissive or security-relevant headers useful to exploit agents, including wildcard CORS and X-Recruiting.
WordPress is not present on the target; CMS-specific WordPress attack surface is absent.
The /ftp/ static-file area exposes directory indexing and Express error details that can guide artifact retrieval, but direct .bak download is blocked by extension filtering.
The application exposes unauthenticated metadata endpoints and well-known files that disclose Juice Shop configuration, OAuth client metadata, LLM chatbot settings, and security contact links.

finding: Public Swagger/OpenAPI specification discloses B2B API surface
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Swagger UI:3000
remediation: Restrict Swagger/OpenAPI documentation to authenticated administrators or internal environments.

finding: SQL Injection Authentication Bypass in Login Email Field

target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 JWT authentication:3000

finding: Cross-Account User Object IDOR at /api/Users/{id}

finding: Hardcoded cryptographic material and weak password hashing in authentication code

finding: Poison-Null Extension Filter Bypass Exposes Backup Package Manifest
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / ftp download handler on 10.10.0.20:3000

finding: Unauthenticated Exposure of Premium Key

remediation: Remove sensitive key files from web-accessible directories, rotate the exposed premium key, and enforce authentication/authorization on any required key endpoints.

finding: Public Download of KeePass Credential Database
