remediation: Require admin authentication for sensitive configuration and remove OAuth/internal model details from public responses.

finding: Unauthenticated Administrative Application Configuration Disclosure
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 /rest/admin/application-configuration:3000
remediation: Require admin authentication for full configuration and expose only a minimal redacted public client config.

finding: Verbose Stack Trace Disclosure in Redirect Route
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 /redirect route:3000
remediation: Validate required redirect parameters and disable verbose stack traces/error pages in production.

finding: Unauthenticated administrative application configuration disclosure
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Node.js Express:3000
remediation: Require authenticated administrator authorization and redact OAuth/chatbot/internal configuration before returning this endpoint.

finding: SQL injection authentication bypass in login endpoint
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Node.js Express:3000
remediation: Replace string-built SQL with parameterized queries/ORM predicates and return a generic authentication failure for invalid credentials.

finding: Unauthenticated SQL injection in product search
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Node.js Express SQLite/Sequelize search:3000
remediation: Use parameterized ORM predicates for search and reject SQL metacharacters only as defense-in-depth, not as the primary control.

finding: Basket object-level authorization bypass
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 REST API:3000
remediation: Enforce object ownership checks on every basket read/write using the authenticated user ID from the verified JWT.

finding: XML external entity expansion discloses local files via file upload
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 file upload XML parser:3000
remediation: Disable DTD and external entity resolution in XML parsers, reject XML containing DOCTYPE/ENTITY declarations, or remove the deprecated upload endpoint.

finding: Public cryptographic key material exposure
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 static /encryptionkeys handler:3000
remediation: Remove /encryptionkeys from static routing, disable directory indexing, and store keys in a non-web-accessible secret manager.

finding: FTP static handler exposes backup and incident artifacts via encoded extension bypass
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 /ftp static file handler:3000
remediation: Do not publish backup/incident files under the web root; canonicalize paths before extension checks and deny encoded null bytes/backups/secrets.

finding: Unauthenticated Prometheus metrics exposure
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 Prometheus metrics endpoint:3000
remediation: Restrict /metrics to an internal monitoring network and require a metrics bearer token or mTLS.

finding: Unauthenticated API documentation exposure
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 Swagger UI / OpenAPI:3000
remediation: Disable Swagger UI in production or require administrator authentication.

finding: Unauthenticated challenge catalog disclosure
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 challenge API:3000
remediation: Restrict challenge metadata to administrative/debug contexts and remove it from production deployments.

finding: NextGen B2B API Allows Arbitrary Customer Order Creation
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 NextGen B2B API v2
remediation: Remove client-controlled customer identity from order creation and enforce customer ownership/entitlement checks.

finding: SQLi-to-Admin Chain Enables Protected User List Disclosure
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 /api/Users:3000
remediation: Fix the login SQL injection, enforce admin-only authorization, and minimize fields returned by /api/Users.

finding: Reflected UNION SQL Injection in Product Search
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 /rest/products/search:3000
remediation: Use bound parameters for product search queries and add regression tests for UNION/boolean SQLi payloads.

finding: Hidden Non-Production Localization Artifact Exposed
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 static assets:3000
remediation: Remove non-production/test localization files from production builds or restrict them from public static serving.

finding: Basket object-level authorization bypass permits cross-account reads
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / REST basket API:3000
remediation: Check basket ownership on every /rest/basket/{id} request and return 403/404 for non-owned basket IDs.

finding: Unauthenticated Redis Administrative Access on Internal Network
target: Redis 7.2.13
remediation: Restrict Redis to trusted clients, enable ACL authentication, and disable or tightly limit administrative commands.

finding: Unauthenticated Internal Chroma API Exposes Collections and Secret Metadata
target: Chroma vector database API (Uvicorn):8000
remediation: Require authentication/network isolation for Chroma, remove secrets from metadata, and rotate the exposed X-API-Key.

finding: JWT Payload Discloses Password Hash and Sensitive User Fields
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 JWT authentication:3000
remediation: Issue minimal JWT claims and rotate tokens; never embed password hashes or sensitive database columns in bearer tokens.

finding: Unauthenticated Administrative Configuration Disclosure
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Node.js Express admin REST API:3000
remediation: Protect the admin configuration route with role-based authorization and minimize returned configuration fields.

finding: JWT RS256-to-HS256 algorithm confusion enables forged administrator tokens
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Node.js Express JWT middleware:3000
remediation: Pin JWT verification to a fixed asymmetric algorithm allow-list (RS256 only), never reuse public keys as HMAC secrets, and reject any token whose header algorithm differs from the configured verifier.

finding: B2B API Trusts Client-Supplied Customer ID for Order Creation
target: NextGen B2B API v2.0.0 on OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0
remediation: Bind cid to the authenticated principal or an explicit server-side authorization grant and reject arbitrary client-supplied customer IDs.

finding: Non-admin users can enumerate all user accounts via /api/Users
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Node.js Express:3000
remediation: Restrict /api/Users collection listing to admins and minimize returned user fields.

finding: Unauthenticated Prometheus Metrics Disclosure
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Express Prometheus metrics:3000
remediation: Restrict Prometheus metrics to trusted monitoring infrastructure only.

finding: Unauthenticated ChromaDB API exposes vector collection metadata
target: ChromaDB 0.5.18 HTTP API:8000
remediation: Require authentication for ChromaDB, remove public docs/OpenAPI exposure, and restrict 8000/tcp to only authorized backend services with network policy.

finding: B2B order API allows arbitrary customer ID order creation
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 NextGen B2B API v2
remediation: Perform server-side authorization for cid against the authenticated principal; never trust client-supplied customer identifiers for ownership decisions.

finding: Unauthenticated Replica Manager Allows Control-Plane Inventory and Replica Creation
target: GENESIS Replica Manager 7.0.0 (Uvicorn/FastAPI):3701
remediation: Require strong authentication and network ACLs for all replica-management endpoints; rotate any exposed session/control-plane data.

finding: Unauthenticated SQL Injection Authentication Bypass in Login
target: OWASP Juice Shop / Node.js Express:3000
remediation: Replace string-concatenated SQL with parameterized queries and use a modern password hashing algorithm such as Argon2id or bcrypt.

finding: Unauthenticated SQL Injection in Product Search
target: OWASP Juice Shop / Node.js Express:3000
remediation: Use bound parameters/replacements for all search predicates and add server-side query validation.

finding: XML External Entity File Disclosure in File Upload
target: OWASP Juice Shop / Node.js Express libxmljs upload handler:3000
remediation: Disable external entity expansion/network access in XML parsers and never echo parsed XML back in error responses.

finding: Poison Null Byte File Extension Bypass Exposes Backup Files
target: OWASP Juice Shop /ftp static file handler:3000
remediation: Reject null-byte encodings before validation and authorize the final canonical filename, not the pre-truncated input.

finding: Unauthenticated admin application configuration disclosure
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / REST admin configuration endpoint:3000
remediation: Require administrator authentication for configuration endpoints and redact OAuth/client/security metadata from any public configuration response.

finding: XXE local file disclosure in deprecated file upload endpoint
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Node.js Express:3000
remediation: Return the deprecation response before parsing upload bodies and configure XML parsing to forbid DTD/external entities.

finding: Unauthenticated Chroma API Allows Collection Write/Tampering
target: Chroma vector database API (Uvicorn):8000
remediation: Place Chroma behind authenticated service boundaries, restrict write methods to trusted backend identities, and rotate secrets exposed in collection metadata.

finding: Non-Admin Users Can Enumerate All User Records
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 /api/Users:3000
remediation: Require an administrator role for /api/Users and return only redacted fields necessary for the caller.

finding: Ordinary Customer Can Create B2B Orders for Arbitrary Customer IDs
target: NextGen B2B API v2.0.0 on OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0
remediation: Derive customer ID server-side for normal users and enforce explicit authorization for any customer-id override.

finding: Sensitive Error-Rule Artifact Exposed via /ftp Null-Byte Bypass
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 /ftp static file handler:3000
remediation: Reject encoded null bytes and remove diagnostic/detection-rule artifacts from web-accessible directories.

finding: Unauthenticated Chatbot Gateway Leaks LLM Backend Errors
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 /rest/chat LLM gateway:3000
remediation: Authenticate or rate-limit chatbot access and replace raw backend exception text with generic client-facing errors.

finding: Non-Admin Users Can Enumerate Full User Collection
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Node.js Express user API:3000
remediation: Enforce role-based authorization on /api/Users and return only the authenticated user's own profile to customers.

finding: Unauthenticated security-question disclosure for arbitrary accounts
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Node.js Express:3000
remediation: Do not disclose account-specific security questions or existence to unauthenticated users.

finding: JWT signature verification bypass via alg=none and RS256-to-HS256 confusion
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Node.js Express JWT auth:3000
remediation: Pin JWT verification to RS256 only, reject alg=none, never derive accepted algorithms from token headers, and keep key material outside web-accessible paths.

finding: Web-accessible cryptographic key material under /encryptionkeys
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 static file handler:3000
remediation: Remove /encryptionkeys from the web root, rotate exposed secrets, and store signing/key material in a non-public secret manager.

finding: Unauthenticated MongoDB Build Information Disclosure
target: MongoDB 7.0.31
remediation: Enable MongoDB authorization and restrict 27017 to trusted application identities/subnets.

finding: Directory Listing Exposes Cryptographic Key Filenames
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 /encryptionkeys static directory:3000
remediation: Disable directory listing and move all cryptographic material outside the web root.

finding: Unauthenticated Exposure of Premium Encryption Key
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Express static encryptionkeys directory:3000
remediation: Move secrets outside public web directories, require authorization if key download is absolutely necessary, and rotate exposed keys.

finding: Unauthenticated encryption key and premium key disclosure
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Node.js Express:3000
remediation: Remove /encryptionkeys from public static routing and rotate the exposed premium key/JWT material.

finding: Any authenticated customer can enumerate all user accounts
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / user management API:3000
remediation: Restrict /api/Users to administrators and return only minimal self-account data to customer-role tokens.

finding: Public backup and internal artifact disclosure via /ftp null-byte extension bypass
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Express static /ftp handler:3000
remediation: Reject encoded null bytes, canonicalize paths, and serve only an explicit allowlist of public file extensions from /ftp.

finding: Exposed Swagger/OpenAPI specification enables authenticated arbitrary B2B order creation
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 NextGen B2B API:3000
remediation: Bind B2B cid values to authenticated users/accounts and reject orders for unowned customer identifiers.

finding: Unauthenticated encryption key and premium key disclosure
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Node.js Express:3000
remediation: Remove /encryptionkeys from public static routing and rotate the exposed premium key/JWT material.

finding: Unauthenticated ChromaDB API exposes vector collection metadata and counts
target: ChromaDB 0.5.18 HTTP API:8000
remediation: Require authentication/authorization for ChromaDB, restrict 8000/tcp to authorized backend services, and block unauthenticated /docs, /openapi.json, /api/v1/collections, and count/query/read/write endpoints.

finding: Static FTP Null-Byte Extension Bypass Exposes Backup Artifacts
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Express /ftp static file handler:3000
remediation: Replace extension blacklist logic with canonical path validation and a positive allowlist for downloadable artifacts.

finding: JWT kid header path traversal enables forged admin tokens
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Node.js Express JWT auth:3000
remediation: Ignore or strictly allowlist kid values, never resolve kid as a filesystem path, pin JWT algorithms to RS256, and keep key files outside the web root.

finding: JWT payload exposes password hashes and sensitive account fields
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Node.js Express:3000
remediation: Replace full-user JWT payloads with minimal signed claims and rotate tokens after deployment.

finding: JWT alg=none Forgery Accepted by User API
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Node.js Express user API JWT authorization:3000
remediation: Enforce signature verification and a strict RS256 algorithm allowlist consistently across every authenticated route.

finding: JWT verification bypass on /api/Users via alg=none and RS256-to-HS256 confusion
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Node.js Express / express-jwt middleware path:3000
remediation: Centralize JWT validation and enforce RS256-only verification with the private/public key pair separated from HMAC verification paths.

finding: Unauthenticated SQL Injection Dumps User Credentials via UNION
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / SQLite product search API:3000
remediation: Use bound parameters for product search and rotate/reset credentials exposed by the dump.

finding: JWT kid path traversal enables forged-token authentication on /api/Users
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Node.js Express / JWT middleware:3000
remediation: Reject untrusted kid values, remove path-based key lookup, and enforce a fixed JWT algorithm/key allowlist.

finding: JWT sessions lack expiration claim
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Node.js Express:3000
remediation: Add exp to JWTs and enforce short access-token lifetimes with revocation support.

finding: User registration mass assignment grants arbitrary admin role
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Node.js Express:3000
remediation: Implement strict input allowlisting for registration and set privileged fields exclusively server-side.

finding: JWT kid path traversal enables HS256 public-key signature forgery
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Node.js Express JWT auth:3000
remediation: Ignore or strictly whitelist kid values, prevent filesystem path resolution from JWT headers, and pin verification to RS256 only.

finding: Sensitive plaintext recovered from textbook RSA-encrypted public artifact
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 /ftp static file handler and encryption artifact:3000
remediation: Remove the encrypted announcement and bytecode from public web roots; never use deterministic textbook RSA or per-character encryption; use RSA-OAEP/hybrid authenticated encryption.

finding: Unauthenticated login bypass via SQL injection in email field
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Node.js Express:3000
remediation: Replace string-concatenated SQL in login with parameterized queries and add input validation plus regression tests for SQLi payloads.

finding: Basket object IDOR permits cross-user cart disclosure
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Node.js Express:3000
remediation: Enforce basket ownership server-side by binding basket queries to the authenticated user's basket ID/user ID.

finding: SQL Injection Authentication Bypass in Login
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Node.js Express:3000
remediation: Replace dynamic SQL in login with parameterized queries/ORM lookups and enforce password verification on the selected user.

finding: Product search SQL injection discloses Users table data
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Node.js Express SQLite-backed product search:3000
remediation: Parameterize the product search query and remove direct interpolation of q into SQL.

finding: Login SQL injection allows admin authentication bypass
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Node.js Express:3000
remediation: Parameterize the login query and add regression tests proving injected email strings return 401.

finding: JWT signature bypass via alg=none accepted
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 Node.js/Express JWT authentication:3000
remediation: Pin JWT verification to RS256 only, reject alg=none, and add regression tests that unsigned tokens are denied.

finding: Broken Object Level Authorization on Basket API
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Node.js Express:3000
remediation: Enforce object ownership checks server-side for every basket operation using the authenticated user's subject/user id.

finding: Authentication bypass via SQL injection in login email field
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Node.js Express authentication API:3000
remediation: Replace concatenated login SQL with parameterized queries/ORM predicates and verify the submitted password for the matched user only.

finding: SQL Injection Authentication Bypass in Login
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Node.js Express:3000
remediation: Use parameterized SQL queries for login and apply uniform authentication failure handling.

finding: Product Search SQL Injection
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / SQLite-backed product search:3000
remediation: Remove raw SQL string concatenation from search and use ORM/query parameter binding.

finding: Unsigned JWT alg=none Accepted for Admin API Access
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 JWT authentication middleware:3000
remediation: Explicitly allow only the expected signing algorithm and reject alg=none tokens.

finding: Basket IDOR/BOLA Allows Customer to Read Other Users' Baskets
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 REST basket API:3000
remediation: Enforce object ownership checks for every basket access.

finding: XXE Local File Disclosure in XML File Upload
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 /file-upload XML parser:3000
remediation: Disable DTD/external entity processing and reject XML uploads containing DOCTYPE/ENTITY declarations.

finding: Public Encryption Key Directory and premium.key Disclosure
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 static /encryptionkeys handler:3000
remediation: Remove key files from the web root and disable directory listing.

finding: FTP Static File Null-Byte Extension Filter Bypass
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 /ftp static file route:3000
remediation: Canonicalize and fully decode filenames before extension checks, reject null bytes, and store sensitive backups outside served directories.

finding: Unauthenticated Prometheus Metrics Exposure
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 /metrics endpoint:3000
remediation: Restrict /metrics to authenticated administrators or internal monitoring networks.

finding: Verbose Express Stack Trace Disclosure via Redirect Route
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 /redirect route:3000
remediation: Validate required parameters before use and disable detailed stack traces in production responses.

finding: Public Swagger/OpenAPI Documentation Disclosure for B2B API
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 Swagger UI / B2B API v2.0.0
remediation: Protect API documentation with authentication or disable it in production.

finding: Public Application Version Disclosure
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 admin version endpoint:3000
remediation: Require authentication for version endpoints or remove exact version disclosure.

finding: Hidden Non-Production i18n Artifact Publicly Readable
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 static assets:3000
remediation: Remove non-production/debug assets from production deployments.

finding: JWT algorithm confusion and alg=none acceptance permit forged admin tokens
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 JWT authentication middleware:3000
remediation: Disable alg=none, pin JWT verification to RS256, do not use public keys as HMAC secrets, and keep verification keys non-downloadable unless required for clients.

finding: JWT signature validation bypass via alg=none and RS256-to-HS256 confusion
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / JWT authorization middleware:3000
remediation: Pin JWT verification to RS256, reject alg=none, bind key type to algorithm, and avoid trusting client-controlled role claims without server-side authorization checks.

finding: Unauthenticated Exposure of Cryptographic and Premium Keys
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 static file handler:3000
remediation: Remove /encryptionkeys from public routing, rotate exposed secrets, and load keys only from a private secret manager or protected filesystem path.

finding: JWT alg=none acceptance enables arbitrary admin token forgery
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 JWT authentication:3000
remediation: Pin the JWT algorithm to RS256 (or the intended algorithm), require a valid signature, and reject alg=none regardless of case.

finding: JWT Signature Verification Bypass via alg=none
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / express-jwt token validation:3000
remediation: Pin the allowed JWT algorithm to RS256/expected algorithm, reject alg=none, validate issuer/audience/expiry, and upgrade vulnerable JWT middleware.

finding: Admin product update enables stored XSS in product descriptions
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 product API and storefront:3000
remediation: Sanitize product descriptions and render them as text or with a strict HTML allowlist; restrict product edits to trusted admins and audit changes.

finding: Basket IDOR/BOLA exposes other users' baskets
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 basket API:3000
remediation: Add server-side owner checks on every basket read/write path and regression tests for cross-account basket IDs.

finding: JWT authentication bypass via accepted alg=none tokens
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Node.js Express JWT auth:3000
remediation: Pin JWT verification to RS256 only, reject alg=none explicitly, and use a maintained JWT library/configuration that never trusts the token-supplied alg value.

finding: Unauthenticated exposure of encryption key directory and premium token
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 static file handler /encryptionkeys:3000
remediation: Remove secrets from the web root, disable directory indexing, and require authorization for any key-management endpoint.

finding: Unauthenticated Prometheus Metrics Disclosure
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Prometheus metrics endpoint:3000
remediation: Restrict /metrics to authenticated monitoring clients or internal networks and remove sensitive/business labels from public telemetry.

finding: XML external entity expansion in file upload discloses local files
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 /file-upload XML complaint parser:3000
remediation: Disable external entity resolution, reject XML uploads where not required, and stop reflecting parsed XML in error pages.

finding: Low-privileged users can enumerate all user accounts
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 Users API:3000
remediation: Add role-based authorization middleware and object-level checks to all Users API routes.

finding: Static FTP null-byte extension bypass exposes package metadata
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 static /ftp file handler:3000
remediation: Remove backup files from the web root and reject encoded null bytes/backup extensions in the download route.

finding: Broken object-level authorization exposes other users' baskets
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Basket REST API:3000
remediation: Validate object ownership or an explicit admin privilege on every basket ID before returning it.

finding: Over-Broad Authorization Allows Any User to Enumerate User Directory
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 REST API:3000
remediation: Restrict user-directory listing to administrators and return only the authenticated user's own profile to customer roles.

finding: JWT authentication bypass via unsigned alg=none token and exposed hard-coded JWT key material
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / legacy Express JWT auth on Node.js/Express:3000
remediation: Pin accepted JWT algorithms, reject `none`, remove hard-coded private keys from source, and rotate all JWT signing keys.

finding: Authentication bypass SQL injection in login endpoint
target: OWASP Juice Shop login API on Node.js/Express + Sequelize/SQLite:3000
remediation: Replace string-concatenated SQL with parameterized queries or ORM `where` clauses and add regression tests for login SQLi payloads.

finding: XXE local file disclosure in XML file upload
target: OWASP Juice Shop /file-upload using libxmljs ~0.18
remediation: Disable entity expansion and network/entity loading for XML parsing, reject DTDs, and avoid reflecting parsed XML in errors.

finding: Poison-null extension filter bypass exposes backup artifacts from /ftp
target: OWASP Juice Shop /ftp static file handler:3000
remediation: Reject null-byte encodings before validation, normalize filenames with `path.basename`, and remove sensitive backups from public directories.

finding: Deterministic textbook RSA encryption allows recovery of exposed encrypted announcement
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 /ftp static file handler and exposed encrypt.pyc artifact:3000
remediation: Never use raw RSA; use RSA-OAEP or, preferably, hybrid encryption with authenticated symmetric encryption, and remove encryption scripts/key material from public static paths.

finding: Broken Object Level Authorization on User Object API
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 REST API:3000
remediation: Add per-object authorization checks so customers can access only their own user record, while full user-object access is restricted to administrators.

finding: JWT not-before claim ignored for forged unsigned tokens
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Node.js Express JWT auth:3000
remediation: Pin JWT verification to signed algorithms and enforce registered claims, especially nbf and exp, for every authentication path.

finding: Customer-role JWT can read full user directory and arbitrary user records
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 user API:3000
remediation: Restrict /api/Users collection access to admins and enforce subject ownership for /api/Users/{id}.

finding: Authenticated low-privilege users can enumerate all user records
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Users API:3000
remediation: Require an administrator role for /api/Users and minimize returned fields to non-sensitive attributes.

finding: SQL Injection UNION Extraction of Security Answers via Product Search
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / SQLite-backed product search:3000
remediation: Parameterize product search queries and prevent the search route from querying arbitrary table data.

finding: B2B orderLinesData Reaches JavaScript Evaluator and Leaks Server Stack Paths
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 /b2b/v2/orders notevil expression evaluator:3000
remediation: Remove JavaScript evaluation of order data and return generic production error pages.

finding: Public Encrypted Announcement Artifact Disclosure
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 /ftp static file route:3000
remediation: Restrict public FTP artifacts to an explicit allow-list and remove generated/encrypted internal data files.

finding: Broken object-level authorization exposes arbitrary user profiles
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Users API:3000

finding: Unauthenticated ChromaDB API permits collection creation and metadata tampering

finding: Session JWTs are issued without expiration

finding: Unauthenticated ChromaDB proxy permits collection creation and metadata tampering

finding: Unauthenticated replica manager exposes operational inventory and secrets
target: GENESIS Replica Manager 7.0.0 / Uvicorn:3701
remediation: Require strong authentication for replica-manager endpoints and remove secrets/compose paths from unauthenticated responses.

finding: Authentication bypass via SQL injection in login email
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 authentication API:3000
remediation: Parameterize the login query and add regression tests ensuring tautology/comment payloads return 401.

finding: JWT signature bypass via alg=none and RS256-to-HS256 confusion
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 JWT middleware:3000
remediation: Configure JWT verification with an explicit algorithm allowlist and remove public-key material from symmetric verifier paths.

finding: Basket BOLA/IDOR permits cross-account basket reads
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 basket REST API:3000
remediation: Enforce object ownership on every basket read/write using the user ID from the verified token.

finding: Unauthenticated internal Redis exposes RCE, exfiltration, and DoS primitives
target: Redis 7.2.13
remediation: Require Redis ACL authentication, bind to private loopback or trusted subnets only, disable/rename dangerous commands, and firewall 6379/tcp.

finding: Hard-coded RSA JWT private key enables arbitrary admin token forgery
target: OWASP Juice Shop Node.js app / JWT authentication:3000
remediation: Remove signing keys from source/artifacts, rotate JWT keys, and enforce explicit allowed JWT algorithms.

finding: SQL injection authentication bypass in login
target: OWASP Juice Shop /rest/user/login:3000
remediation: Use Sequelize parameter binding/model queries and never concatenate request fields into SQL.

finding: SQL injection in product search
target: OWASP Juice Shop /rest/products/search:3000
remediation: Parameterize the search query and constrain/escape LIKE search terms.

finding: XXE local file disclosure in XML upload
target: OWASP Juice Shop /file-upload:3000
remediation: Disable external entity expansion and network access for XML parsers, or reject XML uploads entirely.

finding: Poison null byte filename truncation exposes forbidden backup files
target: OWASP Juice Shop /ftp static file handler:3000
remediation: Reject null bytes/encoded null bytes before extension checks and use strict allowlisted filenames.

finding: JWT alg=none Signature Bypass Enables Forged Administrator Tokens
target: OWASP Juice Shop on 10.10.0.20:3000

finding: SQL injection authentication bypass in /rest/user/login
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 on port 3000
remediation: Use parameterized queries/ORM predicates for login lookups and reject SQL metacharacters only as defense-in-depth.

finding: Null-byte extension filter bypass exposes forbidden backup artifacts
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 /ftp static file handler on port 3000
remediation: Canonicalize and fully decode filenames before validation, reject null bytes, enforce an allow-list on the resolved basename, and remove backup files from web-accessible storage.

finding: JWT alg=none signature bypass allows forged administrator tokens
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 JWT authentication on port 3000
remediation: Pin the accepted JWT algorithm to the expected asymmetric algorithm, reject alg=none, and validate issuer/audience/expiry consistently.

finding: SQL Injection Authentication Bypass Grants Admin Session
target: OWASP Juice Shop authentication API on port 3000
remediation: Replace raw SQL string concatenation in login with parameterized queries/ORM predicates and enforce password verification before issuing JWTs.

finding: Unsigned alg=none JWT Accepted for Administrator Authorization
target: OWASP Juice Shop JWT authorization middleware on port 3000
remediation: Upgrade JWT middleware and explicitly whitelist a single signed algorithm; reject alg=none and unsigned tokens.

finding: Public exposure of premium.key cryptographic material
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 /encryptionkeys static directory on port 3000
remediation: Remove /encryptionkeys from public routing, move keys to server-only secret storage, and rotate premium.key immediately.

finding: JWT RS256-to-HS256 algorithm confusion using exposed public key
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 JWT authentication on port 3000
remediation: Pin JWT verification to RS256 only, never reuse asymmetric public keys as HMAC secrets, and remove public key exposure unless explicitly required.

finding: RS256-to-HS256 JWT Algorithm Confusion via Exposed Public Key
target: OWASP Juice Shop JWT authorization middleware on port 3000
remediation: Pin JWT verification to RS256 only, reject HS* for RSA-backed tokens, upgrade JWT middleware, remove public key directory listing, and rotate keys.

finding: JWT algorithm confusion permits forged admin sessions
target: OWASP Juice Shop 20.0.0 / Node.js JWT auth:3000
remediation: Pin JWT verification to RS256, reject alg=none, segregate asymmetric and HMAC keys, and remove public key directory listing exposure.
